value.description: Carriers of this gene need to ingest {0} on a regular basis to stay healthy. After {DEFICIENCYDURATION} without {0}, carriers will suffer from {0} deficiency. After {COMADURATION}, it settles into a chronic deficiency that does not get any worse. It is never lethal, but it lasts until they ingest {0} again.

This person has a genetically-induced biochemical dependency on a specific drug. Without regular doses of the drug, their health and mood degrade until they settle into a chronic deficiency. It is not lethal, but it lasts until they take the drug again.\n\nTakes effect after age: 13.
